body:
# StabShot

Turn your sword into a camera without changing any real sword mechanics.

StabShot is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that replaces selected sword visuals with a camera model only on your own screen. Other players still see normal swords, which makes the mod safe to use on regular servers as a purely visual effect.

## What it does

- Replaces selected swords with a camera model only for the local player
- Keeps vanilla sword damage, cooldown, reach, and combat behavior intact
- Triggers a configurable flash when you hit a mob or player
- Plays a shutter sound on hit
- Supports Mod Menu and an in-game `P` hotkey

## Configuration

You can configure:

- Which swords use the camera skin
- Flash color
- Flash opacity
- Flash duration
- Shutter sound

Custom sounds can be added as `.ogg` files in:

`minecraft/screenshot/sounds`

Then select them from the sound list inside the config screen.

## Compatibility

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu recommended

## Important

This mod is client-side only.

It does not add a new weapon, does not change item stats, and does not require server-side installation.
